# Major Donor Stewardship Plan

## I. Donor Segmentation

### Gift Level Tiers
- **Transformational**: $100,000+
- **Principal**: $50,000-$99,999
- **Major**: $25,000-$49,999
- **Leadership**: $10,000-$24,999

## II. Stewardship Principles

### The 4 R's of Stewardship
1. **Recognition** - Acknowledge the gift promptly and meaningfully
2. **Reporting** - Share impact and outcomes
3. **Relationship** - Deepen personal connection
4. **Re-invitation** - Create pathway to next gift

## III. Touch Point Calendar

### Transformational Donors ($100K+)
- **20-30 touches/year**
- Monthly personal contact (calls, visits, emails)
- Quarterly impact reports
- Exclusive briefings with leadership
- Site visits/program tours (2-3x/year)
- Handwritten notes (6-8x/year)
- Annual strategy session

### Principal Donors ($50K-$99K)
- **15-20 touches/year**
- Bi-monthly personal contact
- Quarterly updates
- Annual in-person meeting
- Exclusive events (2-3x/year)
- Handwritten notes (4-6x/year)

### Major Donors ($25K-$49K)
- **10-15 touches/year**
- Quarterly personal contact
- Semi-annual impact reports
- Annual cultivation event
- Handwritten notes (3-4x/year)

### Leadership Donors ($10K-$24K)
- **6-10 touches/year**
- Quarterly updates
- Annual appreciation event
- Semi-annual personal outreach
- Handwritten notes (2-3x/year)

## IV. First 90 Days After Gift

### Week 1
- [ ] Phone call from gift officer (within 24-48 hours)
- [ ] Official acknowledgment letter (within 48 hours)
- [ ] Tax receipt processed
- [ ] Gift entered in CRM with full details

### Week 2
- [ ] Handwritten note from CEO/Executive Director
- [ ] Internal notification to relevant program staff
- [ ] Social media recognition (with permission)

### Week 4
- [ ] Thank you call from program beneficiary or board member
- [ ] Photo/update from funded program area

### Week 8-12
- [ ] First impact report
- [ ] Invitation to upcoming event or program visit

## V. Communication Mix

### Personal Touches
- In-person visits
- Phone calls
- Handwritten notes
- Personal emails
- Video messages

### Formal Communications
- Impact reports
- Annual reports
- Newsletter (customized version)
- Financial statements (as appropriate)

### Experiential Engagement
- Behind-the-scenes tours
- Meet beneficiaries
- Board/committee participation
- Volunteer opportunities
- Peer-to-peer events

## VI. Recognition Strategies

### Public Recognition (with permission)
- Donor walls/plaques
- Annual report listing
- Website recognition
- Social media features
- Named opportunities

### Private Recognition
- Personal acknowledgment
- Insider access
- First-to-know information
- Input on strategy
- Special briefings

## VII. Reporting Impact

### Content Elements
- Specific outcomes from their gift
- Stories of individuals helped
- Data and metrics
- Photos and videos
- Challenges and how addressed
- Future plans

### Frequency by Tier
- **$100K+**: Monthly updates, quarterly formal reports
- **$50K-$99K**: Quarterly updates, semi-annual reports
- **$25K-$49K**: Semi-annual updates, annual report
- **$10K-$24K**: Annual impact report

## VIII. Annual Stewardship Events

### Exclusive Briefings
- State of organization presentations
- Program deep-dives
- Meet the team sessions
- Strategic planning input

### Cultivation Events
- Intimate dinners (8-12 people)
- Site visits
- VIP program openings
- Milestone celebrations

### Appreciation Events
- Annual donor recognition
- Holiday gatherings
- Anniversary celebrations

## IX. Key Performance Indicators

### Metrics to Track
- Donor retention rate by tier
- Upgrade rate
- Average gift increase
- Engagement score (touches accepted/offered)
- Event attendance rate
- Time to next gift
- Lifetime value trends

### Goals
- **Retention**: 90%+ for major donors
- **Upgrade**: 25% within 3 years
- **Engagement**: 70%+ response rate

## X. Gift Officer Responsibilities

### Portfolio Management
- **Transformational**: 10-15 donors per officer
- **Principal**: 25-40 donors per officer
- **Major**: 75-100 donors per officer

### Monthly Activities
- [ ] Contact every transformational donor
- [ ] Contact 50% of principal donors
- [ ] Contact 25% of major donors
- [ ] 15-20 meaningful interactions
- [ ] 5-7 face-to-face visits
- [ ] Document all interactions in CRM

## XI. Special Circumstances

### Multi-Year Pledges
- Thank annually as if new gift
- Report on cumulative impact
- Mid-pledge check-in
- Renewal cultivation 6 months before final payment

### Declined Gifts
- Continue 75% of normal touches
- Maintain relationship
- Share impact (not asks)
- Check in on donor's interests

### Complaints/Concerns
- Acknowledge within 24 hours
- Executive follow-up within 48 hours
- Resolution plan within 1 week
- Follow-up after resolution

## XII. Annual Stewardship Plan Review

### Quarterly Assessment
- Retention rates
- Engagement levels
- Upgrade opportunities
- Satisfaction surveys

### Annual Strategic Review
- Survey major donors
- Analyze what's working
- Adjust touch points
- Update recognition benefits
- Revise communication calendar

---

## Sample Timeline Template

| Month | Transformational | Principal | Major | Leadership |
|-------|-----------------|-----------|-------|------------|
| Jan | Personal visit, impact report | Phone call, newsletter | Newsletter | Newsletter |
| Feb | Handwritten note | Impact update | - | - |
| Mar | Phone call | Event invitation | Quarterly email | Quarterly email |
| Apr | Board meeting invite | Handwritten note | - | - |
| May | Impact report | Phone call | Event invitation | - |
| Jun | Site visit | Impact report | Handwritten note | Semi-annual update |

*Continue pattern throughout year based on tier requirements*

---

**Remember**: Stewardship is about building genuine relationships, not checking boxes. Customize all activities to donor interests and preferences.
